labels.label: Grover 3×3 — three builders (Qiskit, Cirq, Qrisp) × three simulators (Aer, Cirq, Qrisp) over OpenQASM 2. Right-click the group → Start: the trigger fires once, QuantumConsensusOracle votes (expect PASS, every top |110⟩). Results: reports/quickstart/ on your host. Change the target in the trigger's test.expected property.
